idea-plugin.name: Marp Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Live preview for Marp slide decks, right next to the Markdown editor.

  • Markdown files with marp: true in the front matter open with an Editor / Split / Preview toggle.
  • The preview refreshes while you type, no save needed.
  • Editor and preview scroll together, the slide under the caret is highlighted.
  • Custom themes from CSS files, folders or URLs (like markdown.marp.themes in VS Code).
  • Local images and ![bg](...) backgrounds, math (MathJax / KaTeX), fitting headers.

Rendering uses marp-core inside the IDE's built-in browser (JCEF), so no Node.js is needed.
